{{Top|ga}} {{Character |type=Jedi |image=[[File:OdKeder-AcolyteVG.png]] |name=Od Keder |homeworld= |birth= |death= |species=[[Human]]''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'' |gender= |pronouns=He/him |height= |mass= |hair=[[Color|Black]]{{Acolyte|Revenge / Justice}} |feathers= |eyes=Brown |skin=Tan |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=[[Jedi Order]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|But before the gatekeeper droids failed, they caught this little scoundrel, messing around our portcullis.|Od Keder|audio=OlegaPadawan-Scoundrel-RevengeJustice.flac|}} '''Od Keder''' was a [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]] of the [[Jedi Order]] who was stationed at the [[Olega Jedi temple|Jedi temple]] on the [[planet]] [[Olega]] during the [[High Republic Era]]. In [[132 BBY]], the [[assassin]] [[Mae-ho Aniseya]] [[Mae's quest|broke in]] to the [[Jedi temple|temple]] in a failed attempt to [[Death|kill]] [[Jedi Master]] [[Torbin]]. The next [[Local day|day]], while Jedi Master [[Cord Taunus]] spoke about the break-in to a team led by Jedi Master [[Sol]], the Padawan brought out the urchin [[Guthan Archi]], who had been caught around the temple's portcullis. As the urchin struggled, Keder told him to stop squirming. Keder then went with the group to Torbin's quarters, where they found him dead. Keder later surveilled a nearby [[Olega Apothecary|apothecary]], and after seeing Mae-ho's supplier [[The Stranger|Qimir]] enter, he informed the other Jedi that he was not the [[Catherio Para|regular owner]]. ==Biography== ===A squirming urchin=== {{Quote|Stop—Stop squirming!|Od Keder, to Guthan Archi|}} [[File:OlegaMasterPadawanUrchin-RevengeJustice.png|thumb|right|300px|Od Keder holds a struggling Archi.]] Od Keder was a [[human]] [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]] of the [[Jedi Order]] who was stationed at the [[Olega Jedi temple|Jedi temple]] on the [[planet]] [[Olega]] during the [[High Republic Era]]. Keder was well known among the Olegans that bordered the [[Jedi temple|temple]], who had seen him grow up in the neighborhood and considered him one of their own. By [[132 BBY]],{{TheAcolyteDate}} Keder was fast approaching his time to undergo his [[Jedi Trials]]. That [[Standard year|year]], the [[assassin]] [[Mae-ho Aniseya]] [[Mae's quest|broke into]] the temple and attempted to [[Death|kill]] [[Jedi Master]] [[Torbin]]. The next [[Local day|day]], a team led by Jedi Master [[Sol]] arrived at the temple to investigate the break-in. As Jedi Master [[Cord Taunus]] explained to them what had happened, Keder brought out the urchin [[Guthan Archi]] and informed the other Jedi that he had been caught messing around the temple's portcullis by the temple's [[TT-8L/Y7 gatekeeper droid|gatekeeper droids]] before they failed. As the urchin struggled to escape Keder's grip, he told him to stop squirming. Padawan [[Jecki Lon]] then knelt and spoke with Archi, who confirmed he had been paid to activate the [[security droid]], though he misidentified Mae-ho's [[twin]] [[Verosha Aniseya]] as the individual who had paid him. ===Investigating a murder=== {{Quote|Is this the only apothecary in town?''"
"''It is, but…that's not our regular guy. I don't know who that guy is.|Verosha Aniseya and Od Keder|audio=Osha-OdKeder-RegularGuy-RevengeJustice.flac|}} Sol then asked to speak with Torbin, and Taunus led the group through the temple to his quarters. Before they arrived, Mae-ho returned and offered [[poison]] to Torbin, which he willingly drank to atone for his role in an [[Mission to Brendok|incident]] that had occurred [[148 BBY|sixteen years earlier]]. After Torbin died and Mae-ho fled, Verosha arrived in the room ahead of the rest of the group. Keder then arrived with the other Jedi, and Taunus aimed his [[lightsaber]] at Verosha, commanding her to step away from Torbin's body, though [[Jedi Knight]] [[Yord Fandar]] soon confirmed that Torbin had been dead before she arrived. Keder remained standing behind Taunus while Sol, Lon, and Verosha examined Torbin's body and eventually determined that he had willingly taken the poison, which Verosha identified as [[bunta]] from her [[homeworld]] of [[Brendok]]. [[File:JediListening-RevengeJustice.png|thumb|left|300px|The Jedi listen to Verosha's conversation with Qimir.]] Later, Keder stood on a balcony with Sol's team and used [[macrobinoculars]] to look at an [[Olega Apothecary|apothecary]] across the street. Verosha explained that bunta's effects did not last long, meaning it must have come from nearby, then asked if the apothecary was the only one in the town. Keder confirmed that it was, but upon seeing Mae-ho's supplier, [[The Stranger|Qimir]], enter, he noted he was not the [[Catherio Para|regular owner]] and that he did not recognize him. Keder remained silent as the other Jedi discussed their next steps, eventually deciding to send Verosha into the apothecary disguised as her [[Aniseya family|sister]] to obtain a confession. After hearing Qimir admit to giving Verosha the poison while listening to their conversation, the Jedi began to move to pull her out, but stopped when ordered by Sol. After briefly listening more, Sol, Fandar, and Lon entered the apothecary, where they learned that Mae-ho would return that [[Standard day|night]]. ==Personality and traits== Od Keder was a human with [[Color|brown]] [[eye]]s, tan skin, and black [[hair]]. ==Powers and abilities== As a member of the Jedi Order, Od Keder was [[Force-sensitive]] and trained to [[Force power|wield]] the Force. ==Equipment== Od Keder wore [[Jedi apparel]] with a brown [[nerf-wool]] [[Clothing|over-robe]], a suede tabard sourced from a local tanner, [[Olegan cotton]] pants, and calf-length [[boot]]s. He wore a [[Padawan braid]] in his hair and a green learner [[Padawan sash|sash]] that denoted his status as a Padawan. Keder wielded a green-bladed''[[Star Wars: The High Republic: The Lightsaber Collection]]'' establishes that the [[Padawan sash|sashes]] worn by [[Padawan]]s during the [[High Republic Era]] matched the [[color]] of their [[lightsaber]]s, and ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'' establishes Od Keder's [[sash]] was green. [[Keder's lightsaber|lightsaber]], though he rarely had to draw it under duress on Olega. While surveilling the Olega apothecary, Keder used macrobinoculars. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|Star Wars: The Acolyte is streaming on Disney+ from today! So grateful to have played a part in this incredible show! Man’s a Jedi!! Well, a Padawan at least|Ed Kear|{{Instagram|username=edkear|url=p/C71C15hM47G/?hl=en&img_index=3|name=[[Ed Kear]]|date=2024-06-04|quote=Star Wars: The Acolyte is streaming on Disney+ from today! So grateful to have played a part in this incredible show! Man’s a Jedi!! Well, a Padawan at least|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/X6Cpr}}}} Od Keder first appeared in "[[Revenge / Justice]]," the second episode of the live-action [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte|The Acolyte]]'', which aired on [[June 4]], [[2024]].{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-teaser-poster|text=''The Acolyte'' Teaser Poster, Premiere Date Revealed}} Prior to the episode's release, he was first depicted in a trailer uploaded to the official ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Wikipedia:YouTube|YouTube]] channel on [[May 4]] of that year.{{SWYouTube|6tzur6JrUEA|The Acolyte | Official Trailer | Disney+}} Keder was identified in [[Pablo Hidalgo]]'s [[2025]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]''. He was portrayed by [[Ed Kear]], who was grateful to appear in ''The Acolyte'' and excited to portray a Jedi. The scenes on Olega''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'' that included the Padawan were shot at the back lot of [[Shinfield Studios]] in the [[Wikipedia:United Kingdom|United Kingdom]]. Concept art of a scene in which Keder appeared was created by [[Adam Brockbank]] under supervision by production designer [[Kevin Jenkins]].{{Instagram|username=brockbankadam|url=brockbankadam/p/C-pwTG4KfRF|name=[[Adam Brockbank]]|date=2024-08-14|quote=Torbin found dead The Acolyte Production designer Kevin
